name: Management dashboard · "Cost & AI" reuses the Analytics dashboard (MetricsDashboard), inline cost UI removed
description:
OBJECTIVE
The management dashboard's "Cost & AI" section renders a hand-rolled summary (KPI strip, inline SVG consumption chart, spend by project/person, by-model table, budget bars). A complete, detailed analytics dashboard already exists in the app: `src/components/analytics/MetricsDashboard.vue` (the "Analytics" tab). Render that existing dashboard inside the "Cost & AI" section and delete the inline implementation.

FILES
- Change: `src/views/ManagementDashboardView.vue`; dead-code cleanup in `src/views/management/useManagementDashboard.js`.
- Reuse AS-IS, do not edit: `src/components/analytics/MetricsDashboard.vue`, `DailyChart.vue`, `PriceEditor.vue`.
- Section id is `cost` in `SECTIONS` ("Cost & AI"), defined in `useManagementDashboard.js`.

ACCEPTANCE
- "Cost & AI" shows the full Analytics dashboard (7 KPI cards, token-usage chart, usage by model, period breakdown table, admin-view toggle, price management for admins) with ONE scrollbar and no leftover inline cost widgets.
- Pulse section keeps its "AI spend" KPI and "AI spend trend" bars working.
- `npm run build` clean; no references left to the removed computeds; no console errors when switching sections.
